underlines.text: there is but too much reason to fear they are not gone to Scotland

reference.text: An express came at twelve last night, just as we were all gone to bed, from Colonel Forster, to inform us that she was gone off to Scotland with one of his officers; to own the truth, with Wickham!

underlines.text: Colonel Forster came yesterday, having left Brighton the day before

reference.text: Colonel Forster gives us reason to expect him here soon.
